name: Design and Media
about: Visual communication, industrial and digital design studied together, crossing art, media and technology, with a Nordic, human-centred and sustainable approach to design.

name: Economics
about: Economic theory with a strong quantitative toolkit: data analysis, programming and econometrics, applied to real-world questions. Admits you to a 3+2 bachelor's and master's.

name: Finance
about: Finance, analytics and strategic decision-making built on business and economics, with attention to socially responsible investment and impact beyond the financial return. New in 2027.

name: International Business
about: Marketing, accounting, management and entrepreneurship taught through real business cases and teamwork, with data skills for evidence-based decisions, on the Otaniemi campus.

name: Chemical Engineering
about: Chemistry fundamentals with a strong base in mathematics, programming and machine learning, leading to process engineering, biotechnology and sustainable industry.

name: Computer Engineering
about: Mathematics, physics and computer science with hands-on programming and electrical engineering, joining hardware and software for fields such as AI, IoT and telecoms.

name: Data Science
about: Mathematics, statistics and machine learning combined to extract insight from data and build predictive models, preparing you to work as a digitalisation expert.

name: Digital Systems and Design
about: Electrical engineering joined with engineering design: networking, automation, programming and machine learning, plus project work with industry partners.

name: Mechanical and Civil Engineering
about: Classical mechanical and civil engineering taught through computational simulation and programming, building virtual models of physical systems; leads on to Aalto master's in mechanical, civil or geoengineering.

name: Quantum Technology
about: Quantum physics, mathematics, computer science and electrical engineering for computing, communication and sensing, with lab work and master's-level topics early on.

name: Technology, Business and Design
about: A first year spent on technology, business and design together in one class (maths, programming, finance, strategy, design), then a major in one of the three. New in 2027.

name: Information Technology
about: Software development for web, mobile and cloud, with a specialisation in Intelligent Robotics or in Data Processing and Analytics, plus internships and research projects with industry.

name: International Business
about: Sustainable business solutions built with digital tools and industry systems, specialising in Strategic Marketing, Logistics and Trade, or Accounting, with work placements in Finland or abroad.

name: Mechanical and Sustainable Engineering
about: Engineering, sustainability and digitalisation combined for carbon-neutral solutions: materials characterisation, product design and manufacturing technology, in small groups.

name: Degree Programme in Aviation Business
about: Business for the aviation industry: its processes, sales, services, business development and financial management, learned through projects with real aviation companies.

name: Degree Programme in Business Information Technology
about: Practical business IT on a theoretical base: software development, digital services, cloud computing and cyber security, with a work placement and a thesis done with IT companies.

name: Degree Programme in Digital Business Innovations
about: International business combined with digital innovation and marketing, preparing you for digital transformation and sustainable business through real company projects.

name: Degree Programme in International Business
about: A broad business degree for a global, digital market, with majors such as Accounting and Finance, People Management, Marketing and Sales, or Supply Chain Management, and close work with companies.

name: Degree Programme in Hospitality and Tourism Experience Management
about: Business, creativity and innovation for the experience economy: event management, experience design and hospitality leadership, learned through projects with real companies.

name: Degree Programme in Sports Coaching and Management
about: Sports coaching, event management and sports organisations in two streams, personal growth and coach development, with partners such as the International Ice Hockey Federation.

name: Business Innovation and Sustainability
about: Science-based business studies focused on sustainability, international business, corporate responsibility, innovation management, strategy and entrepreneurship. Admits you to a 3+2 bachelor's and master's.

name: Immersive Software Engineering and AI
about: Software engineering, artificial intelligence, mathematics and entrepreneurship learned through projects in small teams instead of lectures, with two paid internships in IT companies.

name: Early Childhood Education
about: Research-based studies of childhood and early childhood education with supervised teaching practice, qualifying you as an early childhood teacher in Finland; Finnish is built into the degree.

name: Business Management
about: Business for a data-driven market: digital tools for financial and market insight, digital marketing and financial management, with a specialisation in Corporate Financial Management or Digital Marketing.

name: Service Experience Management
about: Hospitality, events, food and beverage and tourism, learned through practical projects with companies and service design, combining academic study with the skills the industry expects.

name: Cyber Security, Business Information Technology
about: Technical, advisory and management skills in cyber security (networks, information security management, security technologies) on a business IT base, studied fully online.

name: Developing Digital Services, Business Information Technology
about: IT, business and design combined for building digital services, studied fully online through real development projects with tutor support.

name: Nursing
about: Registered-nurse training in English with Finnish support and 90 ECTS of clinical placements, meeting EU requirements so you can work as a nurse across the EU.

name: Social Services
about: Social services work taught in English with Finnish built in, functionally bilingual, with three internships worth 45 ECTS; blended study at Tikkurila.

name: Chemical and Process Engineering
about: Sustainable production processes, separation methods and process design on a base of chemistry, physics and maths, applied to the circular economy, green energy and biomass.

name: Civil Engineering
about: Civil engineering for the energy transition, urbanisation, resource efficiency, climate change and digitalisation, taught in Lahti, with direct progression to a related master's.

name: Computational Science and Artificial Intelligence
about: Mathematics and computer science combined to solve real scientific and engineering problems through mathematical modelling, algorithms and data.

name: Electrical Engineering
about: How electrical energy is generated, transmitted and used: clean energy, smart grids, solar power, electrical machines, automation and power electronics.

name: Electrical Engineering (HEBUT double degree)
about: Electrical engineering for renewable energy and energy efficiency, studied entirely in Finland, earning degree certificates from both LUT and Hebei University of Technology, China.

name: Energy Technology
about: Efficient, environmentally friendly production and distribution of energy: energy conversion processes and the machinery of energy systems.

name: Energy Technology (HEBUT double degree)
about: Clean energy production and distribution, studied entirely in Finland, earning degree certificates from both LUT and Hebei University of Technology, China.

name: Environmental Technology
about: How environmental problems connect to energy systems, cities, industry, natural resources and well-being, and how to design sustainable solutions.

name: Industrial Engineering and Management
about: Technology and business combined: using engineering problem-solving to analyse and develop business operations in digitalising industry.

name: Mechanical Engineering
about: Creative product development, design and modelling combined with automated, robotised production, digital tools and the circular economy.

name: Mechanical Engineering (HEBUT double degree)
about: Product development and modern manufacturing, studied entirely in Finland, earning degree certificates from both LUT and Hebei University of Technology, China.

name: Software and Systems Engineering (HEBUT double degree)
about: Programming and software engineering for societal problems, studied in Lahti, earning degree certificates from both LUT and Hebei University of Technology, China.

name: Technology and Engineering Science
about: A multidisciplinary engineering degree mixing mechanical, electrical, energy and environmental technology with language studies and entrepreneurship.

name: Digital Business
about: Business for a digital economy: digital technologies, digital fluency and strategy for growth, in Lahti; admits you to a 3+2 bachelor's and master's.

name: Sustainable International Business
about: Sustainable management of international business: operations, marketing and supply management in a changed global landscape; 3+2 bachelor's and master's.

name: International Business and Analytics
about: International business with a focus on data analytics, taught through interactive lectures, field projects and real business cases at the Myllypuro campus in Helsinki.

name: International Business and Logistics
about: Supply chain management and marketing studied through interactive lectures, business simulation games and real projects, building strategic thinking for international business.

name: 3D Game Art
about: 3D graphics for images, animation, visual effects and real-time applications, including VR/AR/XR, alongside 2D motion graphics, fine art and visual design, at the Arabia campus.

name: Game Design
about: Designing and producing games: visual design, interactive storytelling and game mechanics, with hands-on work in game engines, extended reality and AI tools.

name: Sustainable Fashion Business Management
about: Business for a more responsible fashion industry: brand strategy, consumer behaviour and data-driven decisions for profitable, sustainable fashion companies.

name: Civil Engineering and Building Services
about: A four-year engineering degree in which you specialise, from the second year, in either civil engineering or building services (HVAC) engineering.

name: Electronics
about: Analysing, designing and building electronic systems for communications, consumer electronics, medical devices and automation, including wireless sensor systems.

name: Information Technology
about: Core engineering, maths and natural sciences with a strong software-engineering focus, learned through substantial coding projects and real applications.

name: Mechanical Engineering
about: Mechanical engineering with an eye on sustainable, high-tech solutions, combining strong maths and science with a practical, learning-by-doing approach.

name: Robotics Engineering
about: Robotics engineering on a base of maths and science, learned by doing, with specialisations such as industrial robots, autonomous systems and drones, and industry placements.

name: Smart Automation
about: Developing and managing smart systems across industries: automation and robotics for manufacturing, production lines and smart factories.

name: Construction Site Management
about: Training to lead construction sites: planning and managing site work and supervising construction professionals as a site manager.

name: Laboratory Science
about: Biological and chemical analysis with advanced laboratory techniques; at least half of the studies take place in the laboratory.

name: Applied Gerontology
credential: Bachelor of Social Services and Health Care
about: Work with older people and elderly care: memory work, digital competence and coordinating gerontological care to help older adults live meaningful lives.

name: Biomedical Laboratory Science
about: Training as a biomedical laboratory scientist: sample collection, patient examinations and laboratory analyses, with quality management and new tools such as AI and genomics.

name: Nursing
about: A bilingual nursing degree taught in English with Finnish built in (none needed at the start); about a third of it is clinical practice with patients.

name: Occupational Therapy
about: Occupational therapy learned by alternating theory and practice, mixing campus teaching, online learning and practical training linked to working life.

name: Paramedic Nursing
about: A bilingual degree that qualifies you as both a paramedic and a registered nurse under EU rules, with skills labs, simulations and about a third clinical practice.

name: Physiotherapy
about: Physiotherapy with a holistic, multidisciplinary approach, including applied exercise, aquatic therapy and water rescue training, plus clinical practice.

name: Public Health Nursing
about: A bilingual degree qualifying you as both a public health nurse and a registered nurse, for primary care and health promotion; no Finnish needed at the start.

name: Social Services
about: Socio-pedagogical social work: analysing social issues and their effect on well-being, and working with people of all ages in their everyday environments.

name: Environmental Engineering and Green Transition
about: Solving environmental problems for industry and the public sector: treating waste and water, and investigating and monitoring contaminated soil, water and air, with field and lab work.

name: Software Engineering
about: Software engineering for the international ICT industry, covering AI, cloud computing and cyber security, with sustainability and ethics throughout and project-based learning.

name: Textile and Material Engineering
about: Sustainable textile engineering: materials, manufacturing and industry practice, learned through projects, lab exercises and work with companies, with options to study or train abroad.

name: International Business
about: Practice-based international business with a required study period abroad and eight specialisation options, including accounting, digital business and sustainable entrepreneurship.

name: Business in Finland
about: A broad business degree with Finland-specific professional studies and Finnish built in, so you gain the skills to stay, work and build a career in Finland after graduating.

name: Team Entrepreneurship
about: Learning entrepreneurship by running real businesses with classmates at TAMK Proakatemia, through team learning and coaching rather than lectures, in an international community.

name: Media and Arts
about: Practical skills for the international culture sector with new media tools, on one of three paths: Fine Art Lab, Interactive Media, or Music and Event Production.

name: Early Childhood Education and Care
about: Early childhood education, social pedagogy and social services for non-native Finnish speakers, taught bilingually, qualifying you as an ECEC social pedagogue in Finland.

name: Bilingual Degree Programme in Nursing
about: Training for Finland's regulated nursing profession, from basic skills to independent practice, with clinical placements and Finnish learned alongside nursing.

name: Automation and Robotics, Science and Engineering
about: Automation and robotics for many industries, from intelligent systems to machines, combining theory with hands-on learning; admits you to a 3+2 bachelor's and master's.

name: Biomedical Engineering, Science and Engineering
about: Engineering and life sciences combined to develop new medical technologies, with lab work and research-based teaching; admits you to a 3+2 bachelor's and master's.

name: Chemistry, Science and Engineering
about: Analytical and experimental chemistry for sustainable energy, climate and advanced materials, with hands-on lab research and room to tailor your degree.

name: Computing Sciences and Electrical Engineering
about: Information technology, electrical engineering and computational data analysis in three study tracks, continuing straight to a Tampere master's without reapplying.

name: Engineering Physics, Science and Engineering
about: Fundamental physics applied to engineering through modelling, computation and experiments, building analytical skills that transfer to many fields.

name: Environmental Engineering, Science and Engineering
about: Environmental engineering on a solid theoretical base with lab work and projects, towards careers in sustainability, water management and industry.

name: Materials Science, Science and Engineering
about: Natural sciences and materials expertise for developing more durable, sustainable and recyclable materials across industries.

name: Administrative Sciences, Sustainable Urban Development
about: Administrative sciences for urban challenges such as climate change and social justice, with shared interdisciplinary courses and Urban Lab projects with the City of Tampere.

name: Social Sciences, Sustainable Urban Development
about: Social sciences for sustainable cities: theory of societal change plus real urban development projects in the Urban Lab.

name: Technology, Sustainable Urban Development
about: Technology and engineering solutions for sustainable cities, with challenge-based Urban Lab courses run with partners such as the City of Tampere.

name: Socially Sustainable Societies
about: Well-being, health and the Nordic welfare state: designing socially sustainable policies and institutions and reducing inequalities of income, gender, ethnicity, age and place.

name: Bachelor's and Master's Degree Programme in Data Engineering
about: Broad foundations plus specialised data technology, in a combined five-year bachelor's and master's, taught on either the Joensuu or the Kuopio campus.

name: Bachelor's and Master's Degree Programme in Information Technology
about: A three-year IT bachelor's to European standards with direct continuation to a two-year master's, aiming for jobs in Finnish ICT companies; Joensuu or Kuopio.

name: Bachelor's Degree Programme in Human and Planetary Health
about: Human biology, global and planetary health and evidence-based health promotion, taught in English in Kuopio with Finnish offered to help you settle in Finland.

name: Bachelor's Degree Programme in East Slavic Societies and Religion
credential: Bachelor of Arts or Bachelor of Theology
about: East Slavic languages (practical Russian and Ukrainian) combined with cultural expertise and theology, studying how religion shapes East Slavic societies.

name: Bachelor's Degree Programme in Lifelong Learning and Sustainable Development
about: Education studies with professional skills and theory, building towards international master's programmes, with room for a large minor.

name: Bachelor's Degree Programme in Social Sciences
about: Sociology with social and public policy, focusing on key theories and research methods, taught mainly online with optional lectures on the Joensuu campus.

name: Bachelor's Degree Programme in Sustainable Forest Bioeconomy
about: Sustainable forest management, the bioeconomy and forest ecosystems, and their role in adapting to and mitigating climate change, in national and international settings.

name: Bachelor's Degree Programme in Urban Sustainability Studies
about: A YUFE joint programme mixing social, natural and technical sciences and humanities to understand how cities and rural areas use natural resources and lead sustainable change.

name: Liberal Arts and Sciences
credential: BA, BSc or Bachelor of Social Sciences
about: An interdisciplinary degree joining natural sciences, social sciences and humanities to train analysis, problem-solving and critical thinking; it leads on to more than a dozen Helsinki master's programmes.

name: Science
about: Maths and statistics, physics, chemistry, and computer and data science in one programme, from fundamental research to practical applications, at the Kumpula science campus.

name: Computer Science and Engineering
about: Software, intelligent systems and secure digital solutions, with specialisations in AI, applied computing, embedded systems and cyber security; admits you to a 3+2 bachelor's and master's.

name: Electronics and Communications Engineering
about: Maths, physics and signal processing with electronics design, computer engineering, programming, measurement and telecoms, then a master's specialisation such as radio engineering.

name: Software Engineering and Information Systems
about: Building AI and software products around users' needs: human-technology interaction, information systems, software and digital services, with a practical, work-oriented approach.

name: International Business Management
about: International business managed in a Nordic style, with creativity and sustainability as drivers, mixing theory and practice in an international setting.

name: Bachelor's Degree Programme in Sustainable and Social Entrepreneurship
about: Business studies combined with entrepreneurship and multidisciplinary sustainability courses at Turku School of Economics, for careers in social entrepreneurship, regenerative business or NGOs.

name: Degree Programme in Information and Communication Technology
about: Software engineering and ICT for varied work communities, combining technical skills (cyber security, machine learning, robotics) with communication; a 3+2 bachelor's and master's.
